claims.summary: The frozen CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL reference lists only EMBEDDINGS under accepted MODEL_TYPE values. CHAT_COMPLETIONS would require a different explicitly supported type contract; no such current value is admitted here. This is a model-definition constraint, not an assertion about a chat service's capabilities.

The reference defines API_FORMAT separately from MODEL_TYPE and lists Azure OpenAI as a provider format. It can be appropriate for an embedding endpoint under the EMBEDDINGS purpose, but changing that format does not establish a chat-generation object type.

The local ONNX example is explicitly developer Preview and still declares MODEL_TYPE = EMBEDDINGS. That definition can represent the documented local embedding purpose once its prerequisites are met, but its local format does not convert the operation to chat generation. No invocation or runtime-setup success is asserted in this metadata-review question.

The accepted type list and the local example both establish the embedding-only model-object contract. Keeping chat generation outside that specific contract is the supported conclusion. No named replacement API, protocol behavior, availability or maturity is asserted; a separate interface would need its own documentation.
